jobs.description_text:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

Empowered to live. Inspired to work.
Compeer Financial is a member-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together team members with a variety of backgrounds and experiences to help provide financial services to support agriculture and rural communities. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally.

How we support you:

  • Hybrid model – up to 50% work from home
  • Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months
  • Up to 9% towards 401k (3% fixed Compeer contribution plus up to 6% match)
  • Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life & AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability, wellness program & EAP
  • Vacation, sick leave, holidays/floating holidays, parental leave, and volunteer paid time off
  • Learning and development programs
  • Mentorship programs
  • Cross-functional committee opportunities (i.e. Inclusion Council, emerging professional groups, etc.)
  • Professional membership/certification reimbursement and more!

Casual/seasonal & intern team members are not eligible for benefits except for state-mandated programs.

jobs.description_text:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams.  Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

Step into a role where strategy meets execution. At Constant Contact, we are looking for an Engineering Manager to anchor our Australian software development team. This isn’t just about oversight; it’s about impact. As a senior technical leader, you’ll be a true player/coach—mentoring our engineers, applying cutting-edge Domain-Driven Design, and staying connected to the complex technical challenges that drive our business. 

You’ll be the bridge between our global strategy and local execution, working cross-functionally with product, sales, and marketing to deliver at speed. If you are a high-energy leader who thrives when balancing system stability with innovation, this is your opportunity to shape the future of our regional engineering success.

AI Engineering Manager

We're setting up a new AI team within Data and AI and are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead it. Good engineering management makes a big difference to how well teams grow, keep their people and deliver, and that is what we want from this role.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description_text:
Flow Traders runs on data. Trading, research, finance, and operations all depend on reliable numbers and a clear understanding of what those numbers mean. Today, business teams bring questions and project ideas to our BI and FP&A specialists, but there is a gap between business intent and the specific, measurable requirements needed to deliver effective solutions. This can result in projects starting without a clear definition of ROI and KPIs lacking clear business ownership.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge this gap by translating business needs into actionable requirements, challenging business cases before they become projects, and establishing clear KPI definitions and ownership. You will work closely with business stakeholders, project management, BI, and FP&A to ensure initiatives are properly defined, prioritized, and measured against their expected returns.

This is an advisory role where you will act as an internal consultant, expected to form independent views, challenge weak reasoning, and drive decisions with senior stakeholders. Rather than building pipelines or dashboards yourself, you will focus on the frameworks, requirements, and processes that enable analytics and data engineers to deliver effective solutions. Your work will help establish accountability for business metrics, improve project prioritization, and ensure technical teams can focus on delivery rather than requirements discovery.

At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.

As a Principal AI Architect, you will own the architecture underneath every FourKites AI agent: the harness they run in, the context they see, the models they call, and the evals that tell us whether they work. Our digital workers (Tracy for track and trace, Sam for supplier operations, Alan for appointment management, Cassie for customer service, Polly for document management, and more on the way) do real supply chain work on a shared platform, and you will set its direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in Chennai (hybrid). You'll write code most weeks, lead design reviews across agent teams, and make the calls on model choice, context strategy and evaluation that every team builds on.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define the reference architecture for FourKites agents: the agent loop, tool execution, state and checkpointing, retries and recovery, guardrails, permissions, and human-in-the-loop handoffs

jobs.title: Product Manager — Digital Commerce
jobs.description_text:
Shape how customers discover, purchase and experience Gallup’s digital products.

As a product manager on Gallup’s Digital Commerce team, you’ll turn customer needs and business opportunities into digital experiences that increase customer engagement. You’ll have meaningful ownership and impact, with support from experienced product leaders. You’ll be challenged to grow, and we’ll invest in your future.

Bring your curiosity, drive, initiative and interest in technology. You’ll be expected to learn quickly, contribute ideas and grow your influence across a highly collaborative team.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain product road maps that connect customer needs with business goals
  • Define problems, desired outcomes and priorities, guiding initiatives from discovery through launch
  • Partner with research and business stakeholders to gather insights, discover opportunities and inform product direction
  • Use customer insights, product data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to make informed product decisions and evaluate performance
  • Collaborate with engineering and design to balance customer value, business needs, technical feasibility and user experience
  • Test and validate ideas through pilots, A/B testing, phased rollouts and other experimentation
  • Communicate product decisions, progress and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership
  • Coordinate

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description_text:
Turn promising opportunities into products that create meaningful value for customers and the business.

As a senior product manager at Gallup, you’ll anticipate where the market and our customers are heading, determine which opportunities are worth pursuing, and lead the development of products that strengthen Gallup’s portfolio and generate measurable returns.

This is not a maintenance role. You’ll own a portfolio of initiatives end to end, bringing structure and execution discipline to complex, cross-functional efforts and making thoughtful prioritization decisions. You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, research and senior product leaders to turn high-potential opportunities into products that customers value and that drive adoption, growth and return on investment.

  • Identify and size market opportunities by synthesizing customer insights, market and competitive signals and Gallup’s data to determine where to play, which customer segments to serve and the potential return
  • Build business cases, weigh initiatives against business impact, effort and risk, and maintain focused, well-communicated road maps aligned with the product managers who own core products

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter, Hardware Engineering
jobs.description_text:
About the Company:

General Matter enriches uranium.
We are designing, building, and operating the world's lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.
In the process, we are restoring America's ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.
Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.
Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.
We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.
Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.
We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.
Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.

About This Role

America is building its next uranium enrichment facility, and the people we hire in the next few years will decide whether it gets built.

jobs.title: Producteur de contenu
jobs.description_text:
En mai 2021, nous nous sommes lancés dans la création de Haven Studios avec une petite équipe et de grandes ambitions. Notre objectif était de construire un studio où nous pourrions créer le genre de jeux que nous avons toujours voulu créer - et auxquels nous avons toujours rêvé de jouer ! Nous faisons désormais partie de la famille PlayStations Studios et nous sommes fiers d'avoir l'opportunité de créer une nouvelle propriété intellectuelle exclusive pour Playstation et de former la première équipe de développement Sony au Canada.

Nous avons fait des progrès étonnants en peu de temps grâce à notre équipe talentueuse et passionnée et à ses contributions exceptionnelles. Nous avons instauré chez Haven une culture fondée sur la bienveillance, l'adaptabilité et le courage qui libère la créativité. Notre première nouvelle propriété intellectuelle pour PlayStation est sur la bonne voie pour offrir une expérience multijoueur de niveau AAA, avec la vision de construire un monde systémique et évolutif axé sur la liberté, le frisson et le jeu, qui gardera les joueur·euse·s diverti·e·s et engagé·e·s pendant des années.

Haven a rejoint la famille des studios PlayStations en 2022, et nous sommes sur la bonne voie pour créer une nouvelle propriété intellectuelle exclusive pour Playstation et continuer de bâtir la première équipe de développement de jeux Sony au Canada.

We're hiring an AI Automation Engineer to build the next generation of IT automations to improve the employee experience at Databricks.

You'll be building production-grade AI agents and automation services that understand employee requests, retrieve enterprise context, reason across systems, invoke tools and APIs, and take action safely. jobs.description_text:
P-1096

At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone.

 

That's why we built AI Runtime, a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters.

It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable, make training fault-tolerant, and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x.

About the job

Expose manufacturing defects in Graphcore’s advanced circuit boards with tests you build and deploy.

Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll take tests from initial design analysis to deployment, then support them in factories and the field.

Better defect coverage means more opportunities to identify manufacturing problems and understand hardware failures when products are in use. You’ll help make test and inspection methods work together, targeting the ways advanced electronic assemblies can go wrong.

You’ll examine PCB testability and susceptibility to manufacturing defects, then use that analysis to define and develop test solutions. You’ll build boundary scan and embedded functional tests, turning your understanding of board behaviour into practical diagnostic tools.

The team and culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team tackles hardware defects across chips, boards and finished systems. You’ll work directly with Hardware Design, Manufacturing Operations and contract electronics manufacturers, connecting design knowledge with factory experience.

jobs.description_text:
Job Summary

Our team is at the forefront of the artificial intelligence revolution, enabling innovators from all industries and sectors to expand human potential with technology. The availability of specialised artificial intelligence compute will be a decisive factor in AI’s rate of progress. Graphcore allows innovators to go further, faster. What we do really makes a difference.

 

We are looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the design and development of complex, high-performance SoCs for next-generation AI acceleration platforms.

 

The role combines strong technical expertise with people leadership and engineering execution, requiring the ability to guide technical decisions, build high-performing teams and deliver high-quality silicon solutions.

 

The Team

The SoC Design team is responsible for the RTL design, development and integration of critical subsystems within Graphcore’s AI acceleration platforms.

 

The team works closely with architecture, verification, DFT and physical design teams throughout the silicon development lifecycle, from microarchitecture through implementation and sign-off.

Build the test systems that prove advanced AI hardware is ready before it reaches production.

As a Test Development Engineer, you will create and maintain test systems for Graphcore’s electronic hardware platforms. Your work will support preproduction test solutions across system and board-level products.

You will define test methods, specify equipment and automate systems for complex hardware. This includes high-speed serial links, high-current power supplies, slower protocols and low-level PCBA debug.

This role sits close to real engineering problems. You will build deep product knowledge, improve test coverage and help transfer robust solutions into production.

The team and culture

You will join the Hardware Test team, embedded within Graphcore’s wider Hardware Engineering group. The team works closely with SI, mechanical, layout, package, silicon, firmware and production teams.

This role is for someone who enjoys getting close to the hardware. You will tune links, investigate failures and turn difficult lab findings into clear engineering decisions.

Validate the memory and system interfaces that keep advanced AI compute reliable under real product conditions.

As a Validation and Debug Engineer, you will help prove Graphcore silicon and platforms work across the conditions our customers need. You will build deep understanding of our devices, boards and system behaviour.

You will create and execute validation and debug plans for new hardware platforms. Your focus will include LPDDR5-9600, slow-speed interfaces, PCB issues, power behaviour and signal integrity.

This is hands-on lab work with real ownership. You will investigate failures, tune memory subsystems and turn complex findings into clear actions across hardware and firmware.

The team and culture

You will work with Architecture, Silicon Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Firmware, PCB design, power and signal integrity teams. Progress comes through lab evidence, practical judgement and clear debug reports.

As a Linux and Manufacturing Support Engineer in Taipei, you’ll support the infrastructure our people depend on every day. You’ll solve problems directly, from support requests to complex Linux and network issues.

You’ll manage Debian and RedHat environments across bare metal and virtual machines. You’ll also maintain core services, including DNS, DHCP and NFS, while supporting on-premises servers and engineering workflows.

You’ll assess and deliver security patching, automate infrastructure changes through Infrastructure-as-Code, and keep technical knowledge clear and current. Your work will span hands-on support and deeper infrastructure challenges, giving you direct ownership of systems that matter.

With new projects ahead, you’ll have scope to improve how infrastructure is deployed, supported and maintained.

The team and culture

You’ll join a multidisciplinary Infrastructure Solutions team where people solve problems together and share technical knowledge openly. You’ll work closely with engineering teams while taking ownership of issues through to resolution.

About the job

Own the factory quality that takes Graphcore’s AI hardware from first builds into production.

Based in Hsinchu or Taipei, Taiwan, you’ll be Graphcore Quality’s lead contact for assigned contract manufacturers, working regularly on site. Your ownership spans assembly, integration, inspection, test and rework, connecting factory detail with the demands of new product introduction.

By closing critical risks before build milestones, you’ll help teams ramp production with controls they can trust. You’ll turn yield, defect and rework trends into targeted improvements that strengthen manufacturing performance and prevent recurring quality issues.

You’ll lead process audits and investigations, taking manufacturing and supplier issues from containment through corrective action to verified closure. Each build will deepen your understanding of Graphcore hardware and help you carry lessons into stronger processes across factory sites.

The team and culture

You’ll join Manufacturing Operations’ Quality team, working with colleagues in Bristol, Cambridge and Hsinchu. Their expertise spans customer, supply chain and product quality, alongside compliance, governance and assurance.

Shape the power delivery foundations behind advanced AI compute systems built for real-world reliability.

As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will deliver robust power integrity solutions across Graphcore silicon and system designs. Your work will help advanced compute platforms operate reliably across complex packages, PCBs and hardware systems.

You will develop and analyse power delivery networks across silicon, package and PCB designs. You will use simulation, measurement and lab correlation to turn power behaviour into clear design improvements.

This role gives you ownership across the full system path. You will influence decoupling strategy, stack-up decisions, bring-up debug and best practice for future platforms.

The team and culture

You will join the Signal and Power Integrity team within Systems Engineering Hardware Motherboard. The team works across chip, package, board and system engineering to solve problems end to end.

jobs.title: Power Integrity Engineer
jobs.description_text:
About the job

Shape the power delivery that will make Graphcore’s next-generation AI compute systems reliable.

As a Power Integrity Engineer, you will analyse power-delivery networks across silicon, package and PCB, turning complex behaviour into practical design recommendations.

You will build PDN models, investigate parasitics, and use frequency-domain and time-domain analysis to understand stability, droop, resonances and transient response. Your work will directly inform decoupling, layout, and power and ground distribution choices.

You will use electromagnetic simulation to understand resistance, inductance, coupling and impedance. You will also validate assumptions, identify technical risks, and connect simulation results with hardware measurements.

You will start with clearly scoped PI problems, supported by experienced engineers when wider decisions are involved. As your capability grows, you will own larger parts of the PDN.

The team and culture

You will work alongside experienced PI engineers and colleagues across hardware disciplines, connecting analysis with real design decisions and measurements.

You will own defined technical problems and move quickly from modelling to recommendations. Decisions are grounded in evidence, physical understanding and clear communication of uncertainty.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
jobs.description_text:
About the job

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.
Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.

You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.
